rules.statement: A Judge has the discretion to refuse leave for a plaintiff to sue as a pauper if the plaintiff has failed to pay costs in a previous action between the same parties.
rules.supporting_quote: The only reported decision in which the Court has considered the scope of section 447 appears to be the case of Hinniappu v. Hendris2 . That case is of some assistance in showing that a Proctor's certificate does not have the conclusive effect claimed for it by the appellants.
